body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2013') Itpanda (www.itpanda.co.kr) will unveil its smart chart for oriental doctor 'HANBANG SARANG' at the world's largest consumer electronic exhibition, CES 2013'
It consists of 'chart function' which enables doctors to write diagnosis with patient's X-ray and 'acupuncture cure' for disease and last therapeutic function that patients adjust pill content.

Itpanda's Hand tremor' application constantly measures its certain extent and automatically send its result to the application. So it is made to consult patient's condition with doctor s, without meeting each other.
